_doc: Promotion-pipeline config (dev → qa → main). DATA file, like polecat-platform's .github/steward/focus.json — editing it is a sanctioned direct commit to main (sessions: pull → edit → push; Manager's Pipeline view: contents-API PUT with sha compare-and-swap). Changes take effect on the next hourly tick of promote-to-qa.yml. Fields: promoteToQa.enabled turns the scheduled dev→qa promotion on/off entirely; paused is a soft hold (schedule keeps ticking, does nothing); everyHours is the cadence; offset anchors which UTC hour the cadence counts from (7Z ≈ 2am Central — overnight, per Kevin); window [start,end) limits promotions to those UTC hours. Manual dispatches of promote-to-qa.yml ignore the schedule. qa→prod promotion is promote-to-prod.yml, dispatch-only, and refuses while the latest qa promotion run is red unless requireGreenQaForProd is false or the dispatch passes force.

gates.devGate: tools/validate.mjs + tools/changelog-check.js + tools/dev-smoke.mjs (ci.yml on PRs into dev and pushes to dev)
gates.qaSuite: the FULL tests/run.js suite on the qa tree, then dev-smoke against the STAGED /qa/ form (promote-to-qa.yml)
